---
title: "Comparison of instantaneous stream metabolism parameters for sites 1 and 2 in East Fork Creek, October 2022"
author: "John C. Ayers"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr.table.format = "html"
if (!require("pacman"))
   install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, skimr)

```

# import the file that has the instantaneous measurements

```{r}
SiteCompare <- read_csv("202210_Site1_vs_Site2.csv", 
    col_types = cols(DateTime = col_datetime(format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), 
        Month = col_integer(), Date = col_date(format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
        Season = col_factor(levels = c("Fall", "Spring", 
                                     "Summer", "Winter"))),
      locale = locale(tz = "US/Central"))
View(SiteCompare)
```

# Spread table with sites 1 and 2 in separate columns with same DateTime

```{r}
SiteCompareGPP <- SiteCompare %>%
  select(Site, DateTime, GPP.instant) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Site, values_from = GPP.instant)
  # spread(Site, GPP.instant)
View(SiteCompareGPP)
```
